title: Active-Trace Complexity Bounds for Moreau--Yosida Unadjusted Langevin Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2608.13467v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the Moreau--Yosida unadjusted Langevin algorithm (MYULA) for the nonsmooth composite target \[ \pi(dx)\propto \exp\{-f(x)-g(x)\}\,dx, \qquad x\in\mathbb R^d, \] where \(f\) is \(m\)-strongly convex with \(L_f\)-Lipschitz gradient and \(g\) is convex and \(G\)-Lipschitz. tldr: 本文提出MYULA算法的离散化误差可由参考主动迹（而非全局曲率界限）控制，从而在非光滑复合采样中给出更紧的复杂度上界。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the discretization error of the MYULA algorithm is controlled by the reference active trace rather than the global curvature bound, yielding tighter complexity bounds for nonsmooth composite sampling.
